gates.whole_family_split_isolation_scope: Generated families only. Legacy original parent decks may have been seen; this is not unseen-parent or unseen-card acceptance.

generalization_evaluation.controlled_draw_scope: Eight physical paired-view controls measure symmetry recognition only; natural draw calibration remains a natural-game result with uncertainty reported.

coverage_budget_amendment.planning_limit: The earlier plug-in calculation assumes independent trials. Legacy deterministic-strategy episodes repeat identical public/action transcripts, so repeated ordinals do not establish that assumption. Budget remains provisional until seeded initial-scenario variation is verified; inadequate actual coverage still rejects.
coverage_budget_amendment.reason: Observed completed training rates imply the prior 32-game development slices are very unlikely to satisfy eight late clusters and two late wins/losses. Choose a larger fixed unopened budget instead of outcome-dependent top-ups.
coverage_budget_amendment.resource_note: Multi-day local collection workload; no new collection until design readiness. Final controlled and reserved-original budgets unchanged because their declared precision scopes differ.

generalization_evaluation.development_scope: Apply the same natural slice rules to development_selection opponents. Inadequate development evidence rejects the candidate before final collection.

full_phase_classification_gate.combination: Required in addition to all existing representative-point and full-phase margin gates.
full_phase_classification_gate.reported: Weighted NLL, Brier score, top-label and classwise ECE, decisive AUC, predicted and empirical class mass. Report zero observed natural draw mass without interpreting controlled draws as natural calibration data.
full_phase_classification_gate.required: Every natural generated phase independently meets the existing maximum ECE, minimum natural phase decisive AUC, and maximum natural draw probability. Require both top-label and each-class ECE under the same maximum.
full_phase_classification_gate.weighting: Same equal-game-within-phase-v1 state weights as the full-phase margin gate.

full_phase_margin_gate.combination: Required in addition to every existing representative-point public slice; no existing gate removed or relaxed.
full_phase_margin_gate.reason: Training-only audit found 21 of 35 late representatives at the last recorded decision. Full-phase forecasts require evidence across the recorded phase, not only the nearest-center or endpoint substitute.
full_phase_margin_gate.scope: All recorded natural generated states within each reached phase, in development and final evaluation; controlled draws and reserved-original challenge excluded from this additional gate.
full_phase_margin_gate.thresholds: Use unchanged phase_margin_learning_gate point and clustered lower-95 improvement floors plus existing per-slice independent/decisive cluster coverage.

generalization_evaluation.implementation_status: Public-slice and full-phase margin gates implemented; frozen-cohort collection and evaluation commands implemented with synthetic tests; real end-to-end acceptance remains pending a defensible candidate.
generalization_evaluation.insufficient_coverage_status: inconclusive-reject; no acceptance and no outcome-dependent extra-seed collection

phase_margin_learning_gate.scope: Every natural generated phase; existing overall and non-regression thresholds also apply.

generalization_evaluation.rationale: Shard0 has only 14 late episode representatives and two winning late matchup clusters. Increase unopened development and final budgets; do not adaptively add favorable seeds after evaluation.
generalization_evaluation.reserved_original_scope: Separate combined new-deck/new-card shift challenge; do not let generated games conceal its overall failure. Apply existing overall thresholds and report all subgroup counts; do not claim precise per-phase/seat/style generalization on this single reserved deck.
generalization_evaluation.seat_and_style_gates: Each natural generated seat and each style independently meets existing overall NLL improvement, ECE, decisive AUC and margin MAE/improvement thresholds. Joint phase/seat/style slices must meet coverage, ECE and existing phase AUC/margin non-regression thresholds.

opponent_generalization.scope: New outcome-head fitting and calibration only. Historical development decisions and frozen behavior-policy lineage have seen split-lane. This does not establish unseen-opponent generalization for the complete system.

replication.rule: Primary and both replicas must independently pass unchanged public-state gates; no best-seed selection. Freeze all three tensor-state digests before opening any fresh final labels. Same training, selection and calibration corpora and candidate design.
replication.counterfactual_rule: Only after all public-state gates pass, freeze a bounded exact-terminal ranking plan with roots balanced across phase, seat and opponent. No deployed search or policy updates until ranking acceptance.

final_draw.scope: Controlled symmetry diagnostic, not calibration of natural draw frequency; paired views count as one physical game.

requirements.draw_scope: Controlled symmetry only; never substitute for natural draw calibration.
